scope: Offline matrix regression on recorded signals only; no brain, body, recurrent cellular state, valence or reward.
features: Concatenate 81 raw-input lag features and 81 sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)/0.5) lag features. Common training-only ridge centering/scaling. 162 coefficients plus intercept.
selection: Independently choose penalty for linear, compressed and combined models on BG0.5 development blocks by pooled RMSE; ties choose list order. Discard first 80 targets within each block. Commit selection before evaluation.
evaluation: Refit each recipe on 20/50 Hz of each evaluation background with frozen penalty. New endpoint is prediction performance on BG1 (Origin DC2) 100/200/500 Hz. BG0.5 and BG1.5 are seen regression checks. No evaluation-response offset, gain, shift or normalization fit.
controls: Linear, compressed-only, current-input linear and combined with training input shifted by 1000 samples.
limits: Engineering hypothesis, not an identified biological two-path mechanism.
One primary cell; shared stimulus seeds may occur. Descriptive source numbers were inspected previously, but DC2 prediction performance was not evaluated.
Background-specific refitting tests a recipe, not adaptation by an unchanged model.
Relative source units, including negative values, are retained; absolute photons, R7/R8 and welfare are not calibrated.
No retuning after reserved evaluation. Seen backgrounds cannot count as fresh confirmation.
